tips.text: Keep cracking relics and bank 410 Ducats before Baro arrives, plus whatever else you want from the same visit.
Crack relics in public squads for more chances at the uncommon and rare parts.
Keep 250,000 credits free; do not empty your account on other Baro items first.
Do not read a months-long absence as a removal; it has returned repeatedly.
Everyone treats it as a Mastery-only buy; take it when it shows and spend leftover Ducats on stronger items.
